title: External inventory allocation release result
description: Outcome of a successful self-release. The holds listed in allocations were RESERVED by the calling service principal and are now RELEASED; their quantity is back in the lots' available quantity and no ledger entry was written.
$comment: OD-M3-REPLY-01 section 3.2. Only a success has this body. Nothing to release is never a 200: a source with no hold of the caller is 404, a source whose hold already ended (released, or expired) is 409 ALLOCATION_NOT_HELD, and a source the warehouse already confirmed or issued is 409 ALLOCATION_CONFLICT with nothing released. A replay with the same X-Idempotency-Key returns this same body again (same lines, same released_at), which is why there is no ALREADY_RELEASED value.

allocations.description: One entry per lot hold that this call released. All entries belong to the requested source.
